ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray to black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels comprising less than 3% of the visible surface area, restricted to scattered point-source clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The base is a contiguous low-intensity field. Discrete high-intensity circular blobs (mottling) are present: a cluster of three in the mid-left lobe, two prominent spots in the proximal-right lobe, and several smaller scattered points in the distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 70-75 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the visible vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3-12 pixels, with the most pronounced jagged topography on the distal outer margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted from the median notch vertex, sweeping upward and outward toward the posterior tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle scarring) are visible: ~10 on the left lobe and ~15 on the right lobe, primarily distributed in the mid-ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical-to-diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the distal third of the right lobe; one faint diagonal line is visible on the lower proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular excision of tissue at the distal tip of the right fluke lobe, resulting in a truncated, jagged profile compared to the relatively intact left tip.
